title: dryopteris odontoloma
intro: Dryopteris odontoloma, commonly known as the Tooth-leaved Wood Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris odontoloma are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions.
